Copy page Copy page The default limit for Prospector, Search, Enrichment, Job Change, and Email Verification is 50 requests per 60 seconds . Your key may have a different configured limit. Account Reporter is exempt from rate limiting. Higher request volumes Waterfall can support more than 10× the default limit with the right setup. Email support@waterfall.io with your APIs and expected volume to arrange higher limits. A sub-key’s per_interval cannot exceed the master key’s configured value. See API Key Management for key settings. Handle a rate-limit response When a request exceeds the limit, the API returns 429 . Rate-limit responses include these headers: Header Meaning X-RateLimit-Limit Max requests allowed in interval X-RateLimit-Interval Interval duration in seconds Retry-After Seconds to wait before retry Retry guidance Wait for Retry-After before retrying a rate-limited request. Use exponential backoff if repeated attempts still receive 429 . Limit concurrency when processing a list of records. For asynchronous jobs, keep the returned job_id and poll the Finder. Do not start another job to check whether the first one finished. For asynchronous workflows, a webhook_url can reduce polling. See Webhook Verification . A 402 quota error is different from a rate limit; use the Errors guide to choose the next step.
